item.title: Cationic Potential‐Guided Li/K Co‐Doping Enables Fast‐Charging Layered Oxide Cathodes for Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
هم‌دوپینگ Li+/K+ در کاتد اکسید لایه‌ای O3 برای باتری سدیم-یون، با کاهش سد مهاجرت Na+ و انتقال برگشت‌پذیر O3↔P3، شارژ سریع و پایداری ساختاری را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in cationic-potential-guided Li⁺/K⁺ co-doping of O3-type Na layered oxides, with site-selective K⁺ in alkali layers and Li⁺ across alkali/transition-metal layers. This enables a reversible O3↔P3 transition, lowers the Na⁺ migration barrier (1.21→0.80 eV), and delivers 181.6 mAh g⁻¹ with 89.3% retention over 1000 cycles at 20C—advancing fast-charging, structurally stable sodium-ion battery cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · layered oxide cathode · Li/K co-doping · fast charging · O3-P3 transition

💡 The novelty lies in using the differing electrolyte reactivities of organic and inorganic materials as a design principle: an electrolyte-facing LiFePO4 layer forms a stable CEI that protects the underlying iodine-doped nickel phthalocyanine. item.title: Functionalized Interface Engineering of Cellulose-Based Electrolytes for Safety and Long-Life Li–Metal Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-functionalization strategy grafting phytic (flame-retardant) and sulfate (fast Li-ion conducting) groups onto cellulose via a ternary deep eutectic solvent. This yields a safe, flexible solid electrolyte with high conductivity (1.48×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹), 5.2 V oxidation stability, self-extinguishing behavior, and long cycling (542/409 cycles), advancing eco-friendly cellulose electrolytes for next-generation Li-metal batteries.
